author: Qiu, Yu Qin
summary: This essay focuses on the seventeen modern Zen verse works (2003-2019) written by Master Chi Chern , and examines how Master Chi Chern utilized Zen verses to illustrate Zen teachings and to propagate the Dharma. As a Zen master, he used various methods to promote Zen, and Zen verses are one of them, accounting for a large number of his Buddhist works. The author has categorized and analyzed a total of 4,555 Zen verses according to the main messages conveyed in their contents, and then grouped the verses with the same theme into nine categories, which can help us to clearly understand the nature and intention of Master Chi Chern verses, as well as how he used Zen verses to convey the meanings of the Dharma and the Zen teachings.

This resolution focuses explicitly on the risk that non-state actors acquire and use these weapons.
